items.text: Los Angeles Rams FINAL: OUT - CB Jaylen Watson (shoulder, season), TE Terrance Ferguson (ankle/hamstring). LS Joe Cardona (ankle) doubtful. Questionable - CB Trent McDuffie (back), S Kam Curl (foot), TE Colby Parkinson (ribs), LB Grant Stuard, WR Jordan Whittington. Matthew Stafford starts. WR Davante Adams on IR.

Washington FINAL: OUT - WR Dyami Brown (calf), WR Treylon Burks (foot); DT Jer'Zhan Newton (pectoral) questionable. RB Jeremy McNichols, DTs Daron Payne and Javon Kinlaw on IR; WR Terry McLaurin and OT Laremy Tunsil out. Jayden Daniels starts.
